Revenant.Description: Some spirits cannot rest until they finish what death interrupted. A Revenant returns with a single purpose and pursues it without mercy. When it has lost track of its prey it wanders slowly, almost aimlessly — but once it sees you, nothing will stop it. It cannot go through salt lines.

Phantom.Description: A Phantom is rarely seen and never for long. Those who catch a glimpse of it feel their mind slipping away, as if looking at it takes something from them. It drifts silently through the house and vanishes the moment a camera turns its way. Photographing it makes it disappear, but its presence leaves the living shaken.

Spirit.Description: The most common kind of haunting — the lingering soul of someone who never left their home. A Spirit is restless but rarely violent, moving objects and whispering in empty rooms. It is the easiest ghost to identify, but do not mistake it for harmless. Burning incense calms it for far longer than other ghosts.

Demon.Description: The most dangerous entity ever recorded. A Demon is not the spirit of someone who died — it is something that was never human. It feeds on fear and attacks without warning, often long before others would dare. Holy objects keep it at bay, but every time one stops it, its anger only grows.

Leviathan.Description: A Leviathan is vast, heavy and patient. Its footsteps shake the floorboards and water seeps from the walls where it has been. It moves slowly and is impossible to miss, but it cannot be outrun forever — and when it hunts, it fills the house with the sound of rushing water, making it hard to tell where it is coming from.

Mania.Description: No one knows what drives a Mania — not even, it seems, the Mania itself. It laughs in empty rooms, switches lights on and off at random, and moves at unpredictable speeds during a hunt. Its presence drains the sanity of everyone nearby far faster than any other ghost. Stay together, or you may not trust what you see.
